    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
nov_fleet['yt_per_angler'] = nov_fleet['yt'] / nov_fleet['anglers']
print("\n=== November Fleet Signals ===")
print(nov_fleet.sort_values('fish_date_doy'))
